The Process of Making Drone Soccer Balls. Korea’s Future Sport

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we filmed the process of making drone soccer balls, the flying soccer balls used in Korea’s future sport.
Drone soccer is a new sport that started in Korea.
Players control drones with a remote controller and try to fly them through a circular goal in the air.
In 2025, the Drone Soccer World Cup was also held in Jeonju, the birthplace of the sport.
In this video, we show how the main equipment of drone soccer, the drone soccer ball, is made in Korea.
Thank you for watching.
